== Biography ==
Margaret was baptised on 16 October 1732 at Kirknewton and East Calder, Midlothian. A derivative Findmypast transcript names father Andrew Glasgow and mother Isobel Clerk.<ref name="FMP1732Margaret">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929'', [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_686209996 R_686209996] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_691904967 R_691904967], companion indexes of Margaret Glasgow baptism, 16 October 1732, Kirknewton and East Calder, parents Andrew Glasgow and Isobel Clerk; derivative transcript inspected 24 October 2026, original register not inspected.</ref> She was born before this baptism; no exact birth date is supplied. Her estimated death about 1733 is unproved. An earlier biography linked Andrew to [[Glasgow-1239|Andrew Glasgow]]; the maintained selected father account is [[Glasgow-1336|Andrew Glasgow]] at 74% probable, while the source names Andrew without identifying which adult profile he represents. The prior profile links [[Clerk-314|Isobel Clerk]] as the mother. The new derivative transcript names Isobel Clerk as the recorded mother, but does not independently establish that the named adult is Clerk-314. A later Margaret in this household, baptised in 1734, is a separate child-event account, not evidence of this child’s death.
